fixed: With Device Sync on, if two of your devices each had a tag, author, level or custom field with the same name before they synced, a saved search that used the one Device Sync merged away now uses the one it kept, on all your devices. It used to keep working for a while and then say it used a tag (or author, level or custom field) that was deleted, though you had deleted nothing.

Natural-key reconciliation (sync-spec §6.6, "The remap") now rewrites every live saved search this build can read from a losing tag, author, difficulty level or custom field id to the survivor, as ReferenceEditRepository.merge does, and remaps an inbound saved search that names a losing id id_aliases holds. Each rewrite is stamped one tick past the search's own updatedAt or now, whichever is later, and published. SavedSearchSpec.movingReferences now also moves the Level filter and the custom-field filters; SavedSearchRepository.moveReferences stamps each rewrite that way when given no at; SettingsRepository.updatedAtOf reads a live setting's stamp.
